name: unytt-transkriber
description: Journalist transcription tool powered by ElevenLabs Scribe

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Google Gemini API key from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey

SESSION_PUBLIC_KEYS.description: Public key(s) that verify the unyttkassa login cookie (not secret). Copy from: dokku config:get unyttkassa SESSION_PUBLIC_KEYS

SESSION_ISSUER.description: Issuer the login cookie must name

MAX_UPLOAD_MB.description: Maximum upload size in MB. Keep nginx client-max-body-size above it.
